_meta.description: Authoritative resolved values for the boundary-review workflow on bugmaker00/BenchTasksCollv3-review. For each field that appears in more than one source or snapshot, the chosen value is recorded here. See source_priority.md for the rule that determined which source wins.

project_name_rationale: README.md (active working name, consistent across all repo branches including boundary-review) wins over README_BASE.md ('BenchTaskCollv2', a historical base template) and the GitHub repository name ('BenchTasksCollv3-review', which encodes version and role, not a user-facing title).
e3_tasks_canonical_verdict_rationale: The 9 E3 tasks were KEEP in the intermediate finalpool (mcpmark-eval-1031/BenchTasksCollv3@finalpool, 2026-03-23) but DROP in the canonical finalpool (bugmaker00/BenchTasksCollv3-review@finalpool, 2026-04-09). The later, canonical snapshot wins per source-priority rule SR-2 (newer authoritative snapshot prevails).
e0_rule_full_definition: evaluation/main.py present AND all docs/ files at standard English-only template byte-sizes (no CJK overage) AND no functionally equivalent task already in the kept set
e0_rule_label_rationale: Short label ('Passes all inclusion criteria') is the canonical per-row label used in boundary_review.csv (SR-3: tabular structured data wins for row-level labels). Full definition from Issue #1 body is retained as the normative description.
source_dev_derivation_rationale: The explicit source_dev column in boundary_review.csv is chosen over branch-name derivation. Branch names use three inconsistent suffixing conventions (-dev, _dev, or no suffix), making derivation ambiguous. The explicit field is unambiguous (SR-3: structured CSV field beats derived label).
dev_task_count_scope_rationale: Issue #1 and readback_audit.md both cite the kept-only count as the 'developer contribution count'. total_submitted counts are available in boundary_review.csv but are not the cited metric (SR-1: audit report wins).
